component.name: QtDMM
component.summary: Read out and record digital multimeters

description.p: QtDMM reads digital multimeters (DMMs) over serial and USB cables, Bluetooth LE or the network, shows the reading as an LCD display and an analog meter, and records it with a configurable transient recorder. It is especially useful for older multimeters whose original software no longer runs on current operating systems.

ul.li: More than 150 meters from UNI-T, Voltcraft, Metex, PeakTech, Fluke, Brymen and others, plus bench meters through sigrok-cli
Recorder with export as CSV, Excel, OpenDocument, SVG, PDF and PNG
Readings table, alarms, calculated values across several meters
SCPI server, so other programs can read the meter over the network

description.p: QtDMM runs on Linux, Windows, macOS and FreeBSD.

screenshot.caption: LCD display, analog meter, recorder and readings table
